The deliberate “Fetch page details” step feels right. Changing an address is significant enough that I’d rather review the new page before committing it than have details change while I’m still typing.

The quiet suggestions are also right, especially with separate “Use this” choices for the title and description. That lets me keep either piece of my own wording independently. The invalid-address and duplicate protections cover my concerns, so I’m happy with this address-editing behavior.
